Set working directory

```{r dir}
rm(list=ls())
# set working directory to be where the current script is located
mydir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
setwd(mydir)

library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(grid)

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

library(PMCMRplus)
```

## Introduction

+ 36 subjects, 5 time points (Baseline, 2 min, 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour) before and after a controlled bout of symptom-limited exercise. Very few missing time points.
+ Plasma and PBMC cytokine, metabolome, proteome, lipidome, and transcriptome were evaluated.
+ [Paper publishing the data](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7299174/)
+ [Study introduction webpage](https://med.stanford.edu/snyderlab/news/May-28-2020.html)
+ [Data download](http://hmp2-data.stanford.edu/)


## Subject data

```{r}
meta_subj <- read.xlsx("data/iPOP/NIHMS1588589-supplement-9.xlsx", 
                   sheetIndex = 1, startRow = 3, endRow = 39)
rownames(meta_subj) <- meta_subj$Participant.ID
colnames(meta_subj)[1] <- "subjectID"
meta_subj <- meta_subj[sort(meta_subj$subjectID),]
dim(meta_subj)
```


## Visit data

```{r}
visits <- read.csv("data/iPOP/iPOP_visit_info.csv", header=T, row.names=1)
visits$visitID <- rownames(visits)
visits <- visits %>%
  filter(Event=="Exercise")
dim(visits)
table(visits$Event_Note1)
old_val <- unique(visits$Event_Note1)
new_val <- 1:length(old_val)
visits <- visits %>%
  mutate(timepoint = recode(Event_Note1, !!!setNames(new_val, old_val)))
dim(visits)
```

Function for creating heatmap of feature correlation

```{r}
plot_tempted_result <- function(res_tempted, dat){
  # time loading
  p1 <- plot_time_loading(res_tempted) + 
    labs(title="time loading") + 
    theme_bw()
  # subject loading
  p2 <- res_tempted$A_hat %>%
    ggplot() + 
    geom_point(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
    labs(title="subject loading") + 
    theme_bw()
  p3 <- res_tempted$B_hat %>%
    ggplot() + 
    geom_point(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
    labs(title="feature loading") + 
    theme_bw()
  # feature loading and correlation
  pheatmap(cor(log(dat, 10)), show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
           annotation_col=as.data.frame(res_tempted$B_hat), main="correlation of features and feature loading")
  print(gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, nrow=1))
}
```



## Metabolomic data

```{r}
dat_metab <- read.csv("data/iPOP/Exercise_Metabolomics.csv", header=T, row.names=1)
dim(dat_metab)

meta_metab <- visits[rownames(dat_metab),]
sum(is.na(meta_metab$timepoint))
pheatmap(table(meta_metab$SubjectID, meta_metab$timepoint), cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F)
```

### Removing features with substantial outliers

```{r}
mark_outlier <- function(x){
  res <- gesdTest(x,20)
  min(res$p.value)
}

oo <- apply(dat_metab, 2, mark_outlier)

log_metab <- log10(dat_metab[,oo>10e-20])

pheatmap(cor(log_metab), labels_row = "", labels_col="")

write.csv(log_metab, file="proc_data/exercise_log10_metabolome.csv")
```



## Lipidomic

```{r}
dat_lipid <- read.csv("data/iPOP/Exercise_Lipidomics.csv", header=T, row.names=1)
dim(dat_lipid)

meta_lipid <- visits[rownames(dat_lipid),]
pheatmap(table(meta_lipid$SubjectID, meta_lipid$timepoint), cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F)
```



### Grouping lipids by types

```{r}
types <- c("TAG", "CE", "CER", "DAG", "DCER", "FFA", "HCER", "LCER", "LPC", "LPE", "PC", "PE", "SM")
list_lipid <- vector(mode="list", length=length(types))
names(list_lipid) <- types
for (jj in 1:length(types)){
  tmp <- paste0("(?<![A-Za-z])", types[jj])
  if (jj > 1) tmp <- paste0(tmp, "[.]")
  list_lipid[[jj]] <- dat_lipid[,grep(tmp, colnames(dat_lipid), perl=T)]
}
```

### Smaller TAG groups

```{r}
TAG_names <- colnames(list_lipid[[1]])
fa_carbons <- as.numeric(sub(".*FA(\\d+)\\.\\d+", "\\1", TAG_names))
total_carbon <- as.numeric(sub("TAG(\\d+)\\.\\d+\\.FA\\d+\\.\\d+", "\\1", TAG_names))
double_bonds <- as.numeric(sub("TAG\\d+\\.(\\d+)\\.FA\\d+\\.\\d+", "\\1", TAG_names))

# Classify into different chain length
carbon_subgrp <- ifelse(fa_carbons <= 12, "MCFA",
                  ifelse(fa_carbons < 22, "LCFA", "VLCFA"))
# classify into differnet saturation
satur_subgrp <- ifelse(double_bonds == 0, "unsaturated",
                       ifelse(double_bonds == 1, "mono",
                              "poly"))
table(satur_subgrp, carbon_subgrp)

list_lipid$TAG.MCFA <- list_lipid[[1]][,carbon_subgrp=="MCFA"]
list_lipid$TAG.VLCFA <- list_lipid[[1]][,carbon_subgrp=="VLCFA"]
list_lipid$TAG.LCFA.unsaturated <- list_lipid[[1]][,carbon_subgrp=="LCFA" & satur_subgrp=="unsaturated"]
list_lipid$TAG.LCFA.monosaturated <- list_lipid[[1]][,carbon_subgrp=="LCFA" & satur_subgrp=="mono"]
list_lipid$TAG.LCFA.polysaturated <- list_lipid[[1]][,carbon_subgrp=="LCFA" & satur_subgrp=="poly"]
list_lipid <- list_lipid[-1]

sapply(list_lipid, length)
sum(sapply(list_lipid, length))
```



### Obtain PC for each 

```{r}
get_pc <- function(x){
  x.svd <- svd(scale(log10(x)))
  kp <- cumsum(x.svd$d^2)/sum(x.svd$d^2)
  x.score <- x.svd$u[,kp < 0.95, drop=F]
  x.loading <- x.svd$v[,kp < 0.95, drop=F]
  sgn <- sign(colSums(x.loading))
  x.score <- sweep(x.score, 2, sgn, FUN="*")
  #x.loading <- sweep(x.loading, 2, sgn, FUN="*")
  #print(colSums(x.loading))
  colnames(x.score) <- paste0("pc",1:ncol(x.score))
  rownames(x.score) <- rownames(x)
  return(x.score)
}
log_lipid_pc <- lapply(list_lipid, get_pc)
sapply(log_lipid_pc, dim)
for (ii in 1:length(log_lipid_pc)){
  colnames(log_lipid_pc[[ii]]) <- paste0(names(log_lipid_pc)[ii], ".", colnames(log_lipid_pc[[ii]]))
}
sapply(log_lipid_pc, dim)
log_lipid_pc <- do.call(cbind, log_lipid_pc)
print(dim(log_lipid_pc))

pheatmap(cor(log_lipid_pc))

write.csv(log_lipid_pc, file="proc_data/exercise_log10_lipidome_pc.csv")
```

dat_cytokine <- read.csv("data/iPOP/Exercise_targ_proteomics.csv", header=T, row.names=1)

## Overlap all modalities

```{r}
sID <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(log_cytokine), rownames(log_metab), rownames(log_lipid_pc), rownames(log_protein)))
sID <- sort(sID)
length(sID)
dat_all <- list(meta_subj=meta_subj,
                meta_visit = visits[sID,],
                cytokine = dat_cytokine[sID,],
                metabolome = dat_metab[sID,],
                lipid = dat_lipid[sID,],
                protein = dat_protein[sID,]
)
sapply(dat_all, dim)
sapply(dat_all[2:5], function(x){sum(x==0)})
#saveRDS(dat_all, file="proc_data/exercise_multiomic.RDS")

dat_all <- list(meta_subj=meta_subj,
                meta_visit = visits[sID,],
                cytokine = log_cytokine[sID,],
                metabolome = log_metab[sID,],
                lipid = log_lipid_pc[sID,],
                protein = log_protein[sID,]
)
sapply(dat_all, dim)
sapply(dat_all[2:5], function(x){sum(x==0)})
sapply(dat_all[3:6], range)
sapply(dat_all, dim)
saveRDS(dat_all, file="proc_data/exercise_log10_multiomic.RDS")
```
